title: Vermont Statutes Annotated, Title 33 (Human Services), Chapter 11 - Reach Up
verified_how: fetched https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/chapter/33/011 (HTTP 200): headings 'Title 33 : Human Services' and 'Chapter 011 : Reach Up', subchapter heading 'Subchapter 001 : GENERAL PROVISIONS; ELIGIBILITY, AID, AND SERVICES' listing s 1101 (Definitions), 1102 (Purpose), 1103 (Eligibility and benefit levels), 1104 (Abandonment or desertion; reporting), 1105 (Child support payments), 1106 (Required services to participating families) onward; the Title 33 index page gives 'Chapter 011 : Reach Up - Contains: ss 1101 - 1134'. Every page of the Vermont Statutes Online carries the currency line 'The Statutes below include the actions of the 2025 session of the General Assembly.' and the caveat 'NOTE: The Vermont Statutes Online is an unofficial copy of the Vermont Statutes Annotated that is provided as a convenience.' No repeal marker appears on the cited provisions; repealed sections elsewhere in the same chapters are explicitly flagged 'Repealed. <act cite>', so the absence of that marker is meaningful.
notes: Reach Up is Vermont's TANF cash-assistance programme and the principal general benefits statute. Adjacent chapters verified on the same title index: ch. 10 Reach First, ch. 12 Reach Ahead, ch. 13 Aid to the Aged, Blind, and Disabled, ch. 17 Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, ch. 21 General Assistance.
